name: SmartLock-7A21
note: Flags (LE General Discoverable, BR/EDR not supported) + complete 16-bit service UUID list containing 0x1815 Automation IO. Deliberately generic: a plausible actuator, not a clone of any real product's identifiers. The device name rides in the scan response, which the Bluefruit fills in from AT+GAPDEVNAME.
